rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something has a strong bad smell.

example.jyutping: ne1 deoi3 bo1 haai4 cau3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5

rows.note: Use this when a film, performance, or other thing is greatly inferior or performs badly.

example.english: I think this movie will stink.
example.traditional: 我覺得呢套戲會差到爆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ne1 tou3 hei3 wui5 caa1 dou3 baau3

rows.note: Use this when circumstances or an explanation seem suspicious or fishy, rather than when something literally smells bad.

example.english: Something about this deal seems to stink.
example.traditional: 呢單交易有古怪，似乎有啲唔妥。
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 gaau1 jik6 jau5 gu2 gwaai3 ci5 fu4 jau5 di1 m4 to5
